description: A row of image frames that opens like an accordion: the active frame grows with a soft bend and gains color, the rest stay dark gray and slightly tilted, and its label reveals with a staggered delay — horizontal or vertical, on hover or click.
interactionNotes: With `trigger: hover` simply moving the pointer over a frame opens it, while `trigger: click` requires a click; clicking an open frame again follows its link (if it has a `link`). Focus and the arrow keys also move between the frames — ArrowRight/ArrowDown forward, ArrowLeft/ArrowUp back.

props.items: The gallery images; each is center-cropped inside its frame. `label` is the open frame's caption, `link` is the click destination and `alt` is the alternative text.
props.defaultIndex: The frame that is open on the first render. It only affects that render; later changes have no effect — see `activeIndex` for live control.
props.activeIndex: Controlled channel for external drivers (such as a desktop auto-tour). When you provide a value the active frame stays in sync, and when you don't the component stays uncontrolled and the user has direct control.
props.accentColor: Color of the bar beside the label and the focus ring of the frames.
props.overlayColor: Color of the dark veil over the images and the gradient beneath the label.
props.height: Height of the row in pixels; in vertical orientation it becomes 1.6 times as much.
props.radius: Corner radius of the frames in pixels.
props.expandRatio: Share of the row width taken by the open frame, 0.2 to 0.9; a higher number means a wider open frame and narrower remaining frames.
props.orientation: Direction of the row; vertical for sidebars and tall columns.
props.duration: Duration of opening and closing in seconds.
props.ease: Motion curve by gsap ease name (such as `power2.out` or `power3.inOut`); an unknown name falls back to the default.
props.parallax: Images in closed frames slide by how far they are from the open frame; 0 means no parallax.
props.tilt: Three-dimensional backward tilt of the closed frames, in degrees.
props.stagger: Staggered delay for the open frame's label to reveal, in seconds.
props.trigger: Whether a frame opens on pointer hover or on click.
props.showLabels: Whether the open frame's label is shown.
props.grayscale: Keep closed frames black and white so the open frame gains color.

tips: No dependencies at all: without gsap the same geometry is rebuilt with CSS transitions and an equivalent `power3.out` curve, adding zero weight.
With `grayscale` on, color is granted only to the open frame — the opening and closing of the frames itself builds a "narrative of color"; turn it off if you want a full-color gallery.
Vertical orientation plus a high `expandRatio` works well for a column beside the page; the final height becomes 1.6 times `height`, so take the frame's placement into account.
The active frame at start with `defaultIndex`, and live driving with `activeIndex`; both are clamped when out of the list's range.
On narrow mobile (under 520px) the row turns into a vertical tiled layout by itself and the 3D tilt is off — as the default.
